apps.name: Gotchi Galaxy
apps.subtitle: A pocket pet for your phone
apps.localizedDescription: A pixel-art pocket pet you raise, breed and take to far-away planets.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Weekend festivals: a new theme every Friday evening, festival tickets, three tasks and a stall
- Crafting: petals, seed pods, driftwood and old relics, and eight recipes to work out

- Decorate the garden too: tap the sofa button and place furniture on the lawn.
- New for the garden: a park bench, a birdbath, a lamp post and a picnic blanket.
- Power, wit and charm now help: more finds on trips, faster surveys, rarer babies and trader discounts.
- Fixed: a pet walking between rooms could show up in the wrong room.

- Away reminders now reach your iPhone.
- Friends hug, jump for joy together, and soulmates hold hands.
- No Flower Gift to send? The tap takes you to the Shop.

- Phones remind you when a trip comes home, an egg hatches or a pet gets hungry, and stay quiet at bedtime.
- Berry Sums: a new maths game in the Family tab, from counting to taking away.
- Flowers grow twice as fast. Tap an empty bed with no seeds to visit the Shop.
- Event neckwear redrawn: flower lei, marigolds, rose pin, rider jacket, snow cape and bat wings.
- Rare looks in the Love Lab now show stars.

- A sofa button under your coins opens decorating: move, store or place furniture in a tap.
- The Shop sells different costumes and furniture each day. New pieces sparkle until you buy them.
- New: 8 outfits, a tiny cactus, an alarm clock and a spinning globe.
- Star Fishing opens for child pets, Treasure Map for teens.
- The Gotchi-dex collects the parts your pets have shown.

- Bred pets can mix parts: a fox with a tiger tail! The pet card shows what each one carries.
- The Love Lab shows each part's odds and how long parents need to rest.
- New in the Shop: a Starter Egg and an Egg of the Week.
- The garden opens when your first pet becomes a teen.
- Friends play together when they have the same update.
- Fixed: tapping fast through menus could close the game.

- Pets sit down properly on a cushion, stool, bean bag or chair.
- Seen from behind, every tail has a clear outline, even a white tail on a white coat.

- New in the shop: a puffy cushion, a painted stool, a cocoa mug and a mint plushie.
- Pets now hop onto a cushion, stool, bean bag or reading chair on their own, and nap on the bed.

- Crafted pieces have their own look in the room: toys, jars, lanterns, a tent, an arch and more, instead of plain crates.
- Small pieces can sit on a desk, TV, bookshelf or fridge: choose Move and hold one over the top.
- Star and mask coat patterns now show on every animal.
- Tails look right from behind, and no tail floats off its body.
- The pony now looks like a pony: upright ears, a long snout and a smooth mane.

- Eight new animals: a polar bear cub, an arctic fox, a snow leopard cub and a seal pup on Glacia, a turtle and a toad in Bogmire, and a black cat and a raven on Umbra.
- Eleven more: a monkey, a crocodile and a chameleon on Fernos, a lion, cheetah, elephant, giraffe, zebra, hippo and rhino on the new planet Sunmane, and a griffin chick on Nebula Prime.
